chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn 'Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah, from al-'Abbas ibn 'Amir, from Aban, from Ibn Muskān, from Abū 'Abdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever visits the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), Allah will register him among those in 'Illīyyīn.

key_terms.عِلِّيِّينَ: A high rank in Paradise, mentioned in the Quran
key_terms.قَبْرَ الْحُسَيْنِ: The grave of Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn (a.s.)?
ai.summary: This hadith from Kamil al-Ziyarat, compiled by Ibn Qulawayh, establishes the grave of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) as a locus of divine proximity, equating the visitor's status with the 'Illīyyīn, the record of the righteous mentioned in the Quran. In Shia tradition, this elevates Ziyarah from a mere commemorative act to a spiritual ascent, linking the martyr's sacrifice directly to the ultimate reward of Paradise.
